status: Synthetic readout-control construction, not an acquired device; no novelty or hardware advantage claimed
model_A: Physical diffusion diag(.1,.02), no excess pump noise, independent downstream sensor OU G with variance .1 I
model_B: Physical diffusion diag(.1,.02)+.1 I, no downstream colored sensor; same G and all coherent/thermal linear-response parameters
exact_plain_observation_law: All passive Gaussian path laws match, and remain matched under arbitrary common additive coherent plant inputs. Sums of independent same-G OU sources equal one source with summed diffusion.
positive_lag_coded_identity: E[(eps_j Y_j)(eps_k Y_k)^dagger]=Gamma_signal(j,k), j!=k, when physical signal is signed before invariant downstream noise; iid signs independent of the full joint pre-code signal/sensor process; signal/sensor cross-correlation is allowed
readout_primitive: An actual calibrated optical/electrical phase/sign modulation BEFORE the nuisance is introduced; multiplication after digitization cannot implement it
upstream_noise_limit: Noise upstream of the phase element is modulated with the signal and remains inseparable. Code-dependent electronics and switching transients invalidate the instantaneous model. A separate causal_filter_phase.py theorem handles a discrete causal LTI readout with fixed nonzero current tap; this simulation is instantaneous.
calibration_supplied: G, canonical readout metric, bath couplings and occupations are supplied equally to all covariance estimators here; separate thermal_bridge.py addresses their conditional acquisition.
